section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the Purim lot (Pur) reveals the choice of Atzmus in Israel, which is drawn through self-sacrifice from the essence of the soul, showing that even Haman's lot was ultimately for the good of the Jews.
section.t: And this is: "Therefore they called these days Purim, after the Pur [lot],"
that the falling of the lot above was according to the intention and choice of the Awtsmoos,
for although "Esav is a brother to Yaakov," nevertheless "I love Yaakov and Esav I hated."
For through the self-sacrifice (mesiras nefesh) of Israel throughout the entire year,
for the matter of self-sacrifice is from the essence of the soul,
that is, from the aspect of the choice of the essence of the soul in the Awtsmoos,
through this the choice of the Awtsmoos in Israel is drawn and revealed,
and through this,
even the lot above was that for the Jews there would be light and joy and gladness and honor,
and Haman and his sons would be hanged on the tree.
And the verse precisely says, "the Pur,"
with the definite article "Hei," referring to the lot that Haman cast
(as above in section 5),
for through the miracle of Purim it was revealed that even the lot that Haman cast was from the very beginning for the revelation of the choice of the Awtsmoos in Israel.
And this is that the lot fell in the month of Adar,
the month in which the redeemer of Israel was born,
for the falling of the lot was from the very beginning in order that it be revealed that even the lot itself,
even though it contains room for two sides
[and moreover, externally it appeared that the lot was for Haman's benefit, to the point that the decree was issued],
the inwardness of the lot was also from the very beginning according to the choice of the Awtsmoos,
"and I love Yaakov and Esav I hated."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the tree Haman prepared, fifty cubits high, was meant to reach the gate of Nun above the chain of descent, and the Purim miracle revealed that even this tree was prepared for Haman himself.
section.t: And likewise regarding the tree which he prepared for him,
for himself,
for the reason that he made a tree fifty cubits high is
because he wanted to reach the gate of the Nun, which is above the chain of descent, where darkness is like light,
and the miracle of Purim was that even from the level above the chain of descent
(lot,
gate of the Nun)
they hanged Haman on the tree,
and then it was revealed that even this, that he prepared the tree from the very beginning, was for him,
for himself.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section concludes that on Purim each year, the revelation is drawn even from the level of the lot above the chain of descent, so that God will choose our inheritance and erase Amalek, leading to the complete redemption.
section.t: And this is the matter of Purim,
that in the days of Purim, each and every year,

it is drawn that even in the level of the Pur [lot] that is above the chain of descent, "He will choose our inheritance for us, the pride of Yaakov, etc., and I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek, etc.,"
in the complete redemption, speedily and truly.
